description: Shows the platform-managed webhook (tgcloud webhook): URL, allowed_updates, pending update count, the last delivery error, and whether it is in sync with the deployed handlers. First step when a bot is silent. Deploying or removing a handler can leave it out of sync.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

title: Webhook status
